sourceContract: Claude Code hook JSON protocol (PostCompact), read from the shipped CLI's own hook-input schemas: trigger plus compact_summary, and no token counter of any kind
author: otel-hook claude-code provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Shape only; session id and paths are fabricated. compact_summary is an invented placeholder sentence: no real conversation summary is reproduced, and the adapter never reads the field in the first place.
licenseBasis: Original synthetic authorship: field names reproduce a third-party CLI's documented hook contract, all values are this repository's own.
notes: The unembellished upstream PostCompact. Pins two claims: compaction.performed is emitted with no context-token figures because the provider reports none, and compact_summary never reaches an event because it is conversation content the adapter does not read.
